repo_notes.content:
sfn-diagram is a TypeScript library and CLI that renders AWS Step Functions state machines as SVG, Mermaid, HTML or PNG diagrams.

AGENTS.md is the authoritative summary of the public API: the entry points (sfn-diagram, /png, /aws, /cfn, /terraform, /ci, /element, /element/auto), which runtimes each supports, the single-object-parameter calling convention and common mistakes. Prefer it and the source over CLAUDE.md, which holds contributor notes and is partly out of date (the repo uses pnpm, the SVG renderer is not D3-based, and exportPng lives in sfn-diagram/png, not the root).

The repo is a monorepo. The root package (src/) is the library and CLI. packages/sfn-diagram-react is a React wrapper, packages/vscode-sfn-diagram the VS Code extension, packages/github-action-sfn-diagram the GitHub Action, and site/ the Astro Starlight docs site with a browser playground (sfn.yusufaf.dev).

The rendering pipeline is: parse ASL into a graph (src/AslParser.ts, src/graph/), lay it out with dagre and catch lanes (src/layout/), then render (src/renderers/). Orthogonal edge routing is opt-in (edgeStyle: 'orthogonal') and runs at render time. The SVG renderer builds strings without a DOM, so the core runs in Node, browsers and edge runtimes.

Ignore generated and build output: src/renderers/viewer/*.generated.ts, custom-elements.json, packages/*/dist, packages/*/out, tests/__snapshots__ and CHANGELOG.md files. Version strings in package.json, jsr.json and the docs are rewritten by release-please.

Releases are automated with release-please, one component per package. Nobody bumps versions or publishes by hand.

pages.title: Overview
pages.purpose: What sfn-diagram does, its outputs, the packages in this monorepo and how they fit together.

pages.title: Getting Started
pages.purpose: Install from npm or JSR, the quick-start example, and rendering a first diagram from the CLI.

pages.title: Public API and Entry Points
pages.purpose: Each import path, what it exports and its runtime support, following AGENTS.md: the function API (generateSvg, generateMermaid, generateHtml, generateDiagram), the class-based SfnDiagramGenerator with its layout cache, and the single-object-parameter calling convention.

pages.title: Diagram Options and Themes
pages.purpose: DiagramOptions: layout direction, edge style, light/dark/custom themes, collapsing containers and per-node or per-edge overrides.

pages.title: Infrastructure Inputs
pages.purpose: Extracting ASL from CloudFormation, SAM and CDK templates (extractAslFromTemplate in sfn-diagram/cfn) and Terraform configs (extractAslFromTerraform in sfn-diagram/terraform), and reshaping a DescribeStateMachine response with generateFromAwsResponse from the root entry. Fetching a live definition is a CLI feature (src/cliAws.ts).

pages.title: PNG Export
pages.purpose: exportPng in sfn-diagram/png: the default resvg engine, the opt-in node-html-to-image engine, both loaded as optional peer dependencies, and why PNG export is Node-only.

pages.title: Web Component
pages.purpose: The <sfn-diagram> custom element in sfn-diagram/element and sfn-diagram/element/auto.

pages.title: Linting
pages.purpose: lintAsl, a public root export: the rules it checks and the LintDiagnostic it returns.

pages.title: Architecture
pages.purpose: The pipeline from ASL definition to rendered diagram, and where each stage lives.

pages.title: ASL Parsing and Graph Model
pages.purpose: AslParser, the node and edge graph, containers (Parallel and Map), catch handling and collapsing.

pages.title: Layout
pages.purpose: DagreLayout, catch lanes, edge labels and the layout cache, plus the opt-in orthogonal edge routing that the SVG renderer applies.

pages.title: Renderers
pages.purpose: The DOM-free SVG builder, the Mermaid renderer and the interactive HTML viewer.

pages.title: Diff and Execution Overlays
pages.purpose: Comparing two definitions (src/diff.ts) and overlaying an execution (src/execution.ts), with execution history from fetchExecutionHistory in sfn-diagram/aws, fetchExecutionForOverlay in sfn-diagram/ci, or an execution ARN passed to the CLI.

pages.title: Command-Line Interface
pages.purpose: CLI commands and flags, the sfn-diagram.config file, watch and follow modes, and AWS input.

pages.title: Redaction
pages.purpose: The redact option (src/redact.ts): hiding state ASL and execution payloads from generated HTML documents, and what it deliberately leaves visible.

pages.title: CI and Pull Request Comments
pages.purpose: The sfn-diagram/ci building blocks (changed-file detection, comment assembly, execution lookup) and GitLab merge-request comments. The GitHub Action has its own page under Integrations.

pages.title: Integrations
pages.purpose: Overview of the React wrapper, VS Code extension, GitHub Action and docs-site playground.

pages.title: React Wrapper
pages.purpose: packages/sfn-diagram-react: the SfnDiagram component and the useSfnDiagram hook.

pages.title: VS Code Extension
pages.purpose: packages/vscode-sfn-diagram: the live preview panel and how it uses the library.

pages.title: GitHub Action
pages.purpose: packages/github-action-sfn-diagram: diagrams of changed state machines posted as pull request comments, and its Marketplace mirror.

pages.title: Docs Site and Playground
pages.purpose: The Starlight site in site/, its generated API reference and the browser playground.

pages.title: Testing and Releases
pages.purpose: pnpm test: the generated-file checks it runs first (test:viewer-script, test:manifest), then the unit, element and perf vitest projects, with snapshot tests; and the release-please flow for each package.
